jobs.theJob: You'd do manual testing — clicking through features, writing up bugs, documenting results — on the contract-management system the Department of Veterans Affairs uses, on an Agile team. The JD asks for testing knowledge and the ability to become proficient in their C#/.NET stack — not hands-on C# experience.
fits: Manual testing with solid documentation — your QA lane. · "Knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines" — Git is on your resume. · "Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance" — sponsored, an obtainable door like the TEKsystems Secret.
A federal VA program on the resume — the federal-employment lane you're aiming at.
jobs.trade: Thin money ($418 over your minimum) and manual testing in a C#/.NET shop instead of your Python automation — in exchange for a federal program door and a sponsored Public Trust clearance that travels. Your word: promote or discard.
jobs.watch: Apply path: the employer's own site or Dice — never the applyre.com aggregator mirror (it carries an app-password artifact; don't touch it).
